_about: DELTA's own contracts table (legal compliance plan, step 8). Built from public news reports and the draft, never copied from OverTheCap or Spotrac pages; every row names its source. NOTHING ON THE SITE READS THIS FILE YET: the site keeps using the nflverse/OTC feed until the table is complete and the owner has seen a before-and-after list of every DELTA Score it would move. The Score reads only `end` (last season under contract). `aav` and `total` are in millions and display-only; null means none shown (rookie deals show 'Rookie Deal'). `kind`: rookie, rookie_option (fifth-year option picked up), veteran, extension. A row with `pending` waits on the owner because it disagrees with the feed. Rows that agree with the feed went in without owner review (owner's rule, 25 Oct 2026).
rookie_rule: Drafted players: four-year deal, draft year to draft year + 3. First-rounders add draft year + 4 only once the team picks up the fifth-year option (decided each May of year + 3). Players from the last three classes cannot sign extensions until after their third season.
